description: Newest job postings ('projects') from Wantedly's public projects API, mostly Japanese employers: title, company name, location, what they look for (e.g. remote OK), publish time, page link. Pay and description are not returned. Text is in the language the employer wrote it, usually Japanese. Choose this tool for: Newest job postings from Wantedly's public projects API. Close alternatives on this server: jobs_nodesk_remote_jobs (Newest remote job postings from NoDesk's public RSS feed); jobs_weworkremotely (Newest remote job postings from We Work Remotely's public). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
